title: Add screen-reader skill management and explicit invocation
objective: Provide the same management and user-invocation semantics in screen-reader mode with linear, accessible output.
context: Complete one low-conflict slice of the accepted live skill catalog and cache-preserving design.
The worktree is shared and dirty; only owned_files may be modified.

source_evidence.note: Developer-context initial catalog and progressive disclosure inspiration.
Live discovery, visibility overrides, and skill lifecycle inspiration.

include: Route /skills state/scope commands through the shared backend.
Route explicit /name skill invocation under the same ambiguity and visibility rules as TUI.
Emit stable plain text without control sequences or hidden-only data.
Put every new user-visible screen-reader string behind semantic i18n keys with translations for all supported languages.
Filter RoleDeveloper catalog metadata from the human-readable transcript.
exclude: Do not modify production files owned by another task.
Do not add dependencies or perform unrelated refactors.

implementation_steps: Add minimal routing using shared command/tool interfaces.
acceptance_criteria: Screen-reader and TUI enforce identical policy.
All new user-visible copy uses semantic i18n keys and the active runtime language.
Developer catalog messages are not printed as user or assistant conversation text.
dispatch_prompt: Implement screen-reader /skills and explicit skill invocation routing with focused new tests. Do not modify shared command/tool implementations.
notes_for_assignee: If verification exposes a defect in another owner's production file, report the exact failing test and owner task; do not patch across ownership boundaries.
